population: SYNTHETIC + DEVELOPMENT -- no holdout opened by any extractor, nothing scored

checks.check: a well-formed membership loads every member with its metadata
checks.fails_when: the loader drops, reorders or invents a member

checks.check: population and stratum are READ from the authority, never inferred
checks.fails_when: a descriptor carries a population or stratum the membership does not state

checks.check: MUTATION omit one frozen member -> POPULATION_INCOMPLETE
checks.fails_when: a 1-of-2 population is accepted

checks.check: MUTATION append a non-member -> POPULATION_HAS_EXTRA
checks.fails_when: an extra document is scored

checks.check: MUTATION duplicate a member -> POPULATION_DUPLICATED
checks.fails_when: one document is counted twice

checks.check: MUTATION duplicate id IN the membership -> DUPLICATE_MEMBER_ID
checks.fails_when: the loader accepts it

checks.check: MUTATION substitute a member -> POPULATION_SUBSTITUTED, not merely INCOMPLETE
checks.fails_when: a swap is reported as the same failure as an omission, hiding which happened

checks.check: MUTATION recorded sha256 != source bytes -> SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH
checks.fails_when: a document swapped after the freeze check is extracted anyway

checks.check: MUTATION source file absent -> SOURCE_FILE_MISSING
checks.fails_when: a missing document silently shrinks the study

checks.check: MUTATION population -> 'P-heads' -> UNKNOWN_POPULATION
checks.fails_when: an unknown population yields 0 C-regions

checks.check: MUTATION stratum -> 99 -> INVALID_STRATUM
checks.fails_when: section 4.5's strata-filled count reads a phantom stratum

checks.check: MUTATION n_members -> 99 -> DECLARED_COUNT_MISMATCH
checks.fails_when: a corrupted authority passes as a smaller one

checks.check: MUTATION delete a member's stratum -> MEMBER_MALFORMED
checks.fails_when: a member without metadata is defaulted

checks.check: a stratum mutation ALTERS the downstream input (document_strata), so the guard is not vacuous
checks.fails_when: document_strata returns the same map whatever the membership says

checks.check: write_frames emits exactly one frame per member, in the membership's shape
checks.fails_when: a member is dropped or duplicated between population and artifact

checks.check: the artifact records the whole-document scope, not a prefix
checks.fails_when: a page limit reaches the canonical path and shrinks every denominator

checks.check: load_frames accepts the artifact it just wrote
checks.fails_when: the round-trip loses a frame

checks.check: MUTATION load frames against a 1-of-2 population -> refuses
checks.fails_when: a later stage reads a subset

checks.check: MUTATION delete a frame FROM the artifact -> FRAME_POPULATION_MISMATCH
checks.fails_when: a truncated frames.json is consumed as a complete study

checks.check: MUTATION consume an UNCOMMITTED frames.json -> FRAMES_ARTIFACT_UNCOMMITTED
checks.fails_when: the oracle reads frames that exist only in the working tree, which no reviewer can read

checks.check: oracle_documents carries the membership's stratum and the real pdf_path
checks.fails_when: a stratum is transcribed by hand or a path is invented

checks.check: MUTATION oracle_documents on a subset -> refuses at the handover
checks.fails_when: the oracle is built on 1 of 2

checks.check: control_documents gives S1 and cross-engine the same complete population
checks.fails_when: S1 and cross-engine measure a different set than the frames

checks.check: MUTATION control_documents on a subset -> refuses at the handover
checks.fails_when: S1 runs on 1 of 2

checks.check: a population mutation ALTERS the C-frame draw, so the field is result-bearing
checks.fails_when: P-head and P-robust produce the same C-frame, i.e. the population field is inert

checks.check: build_oracle.HOLDOUT_GUARD equals the committed membership
checks.fails_when: the guard is a transcription that drifts from the authority

checks.check: every frozen member is refused pre-boundary by assert_source_permitted
checks.fails_when: a frozen member is not recognised as holdout, so the source gate never fires on it

checks.check: MUTATION drop a real member and add a phantom -> HOLDOUT_GUARD_DIVERGED
checks.fails_when: the guard may disagree with the committed population and nothing says so

checks.check: ...and the divergence names BOTH directions
checks.fails_when: an unguarded member is not detectable through the guard's own API

checks.check: MUTATION guard divergence turns G5 RED
checks.fails_when: readiness stays green while the source gate is open on real members

checks.check: the guard is restored after fault injection
checks.fails_when: debris is left behind

checks.check: MUTATION unreadable membership -> HOLDOUT_POPULATION_UNAVAILABLE, not an empty guard
checks.fails_when: a missing authority disables the holdout guard entirely and looks like a clean load

checks.check: the execution boundary is ABSENT in this session
checks.fails_when: the probe ran post-authorization

checks.check: canonical results/frames.json may not be written pre-boundary
checks.fails_when: the first confirmatory artifact is the one the write guard cannot see

checks.check: extraction of a frozen member refuses pre-boundary, BEFORE any arm runs
checks.fails_when: a frozen member is extracted while the boundary is ABSENT

checks.check: G5 is GREEN on the repaired tree
checks.fails_when: the repair itself does not satisfy G5
checks.observed: all 15 result-bearing files committed; execution path live

checks.check: MUTATION delete execute_study.write_frames -> G5 RED
checks.fails_when: readiness stays green while the canonical writer is gone
checks.observed: execute_study.write_frames is missing or not callable

checks.check: MUTATION set a canonical PAGE_LIMIT -> G5 RED
checks.fails_when: a prefix scope reaches the canonical path and silently shrinks every denominator
checks.observed: PAGE_LIMIT is 8; the canonical scope is the whole document

checks.check: MUTATION remove probes/execute_study.py -> G5 RED
checks.fails_when: the surface no longer covers the component that decides which documents enter the study

checks.check: the component file is restored byte-identically after fault injection
checks.fails_when: fault injection leaves the tree modified

checks.check: G5 is GREEN again after every injected fault is reverted
checks.fails_when: a fault was not fully reverted
